facts.fact: 六月南德州热得要命——接机大厅、连环延误把早班机变成午班。
facts.anchor: June in south Texas is unbearably fucking hot.

facts.fact: 「在等人吗，devil？」——她扔下行李箱跳进他怀里；他总是接得住她。
毕业捷报：三月完成实习、留任到毕业、十天前毕业礼——Brooks 与父母飞去观礼。
facts.anchor: I graduated ten days ago, and Brooks and my parents flew out to watch me cross the stage.

facts.fact: 过去九个月是人生最好也最坏的九个月。
facts.anchor: The last nine months have been the best and worst of my life.

facts.fact: 平安夜回家见两周大的 Zachary Silas Forbes；Emmy 牛主题三岁生日（12/27）；Ev 12/29 赴伦敦。
facts.anchor: I flew in on Christmas Eve to meet two-week-old Zachary Silas Forbes, the newest member of the family.

facts.fact: 圣诞后 Brooks 夜夜在她床上打电话——她走后他没怎么离开过她的小屋。
facts.anchor: Brooks was calling me from my bed at night, rather than his own.

facts.fact: Ev 夫妇结婚一周年——也是她回家疗心即将一周年。
facts.anchor: celebrate a year of marriage. It’s crazy to think it’s only been a year

facts.fact: 抬杠：永远是骗局——马、卡车、连很棒的性都不会永远；他抢答好性爱会永远。
facts.anchor: “We’ll always have great sex,” he interjects.

facts.fact: 他的誓言：八十岁也还是你——就算神话也要给 forever 拼一次：你和我 devil，我们是 destiny。
她的回应含泪微笑：Me and you, demon——他总是看见她。
她坦白最近去过一些黑暗的地方——妈妈会怕、哥哥会捶墙的地方。
facts.anchor: Places that would have had my mom scared, had she known about them.

facts.fact: 地图答案：从不需要地图——只需要心；心总带她去该去的地方。
facts.anchor: But it turns out I never needed a map. I just needed my heart.

facts.fact: 终句：就在牧场上——带着一个属于她自己的 Hart。
facts.anchor: Right here on the ranch, with a Hart of my very own.
